# Browser-facing base URLs. Localhost by default, or https://<port>-$WEB_HOST behind
# a reverse proxy. Consumed by docker-compose.yaml (Keycloak hostname + oauth2-proxy) and
# process-compose.yaml (frontend). Regenerate .env after switching between plain-localhost and reverse-proxy setups.
FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000
KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9090
S3_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000
TEMPORAL_UI_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:8233
OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECURE=false

# Local Keycloak login user (seeded by the keycloak-bootstrap container)
LOCAL_USER_ID=824c02e4-4aa3-4edb-ab7a-d1ce7415950e
LOCAL_USER_EMAIL=spark@example.com
LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD=***REDACTED***
LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME=Spark
LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME=User

# External LiteLLM-compatible endpoint
LITELLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000
LITELLM_MASTER_KEY=***REDACTED***
LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL=text-embedding-3-small
LITELLM_VISUAL_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini

# External Docling endpoint
DOCLING_PROTOCOL=http
DOCLING_HOST=localhost
DOCLING_PORT=5001
DOCLING_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5001
DOCLING_OCR_ENGINE=rapidocr
DOCLING_TIMEOUT=600
=== override ===
# Local override: the upstream `minio/minio` and `minio/mc` Docker Hub repositories are no
# longer publicly pullable, so substitute the Bitnami MinIO images (same CLI/env contract).
services:
  minio:
    image: bitnamilegacy/minio:latest
    user: "0"
  minio-init:
    image: bitnamilegacy/minio-client:latest

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat .env | sed 's/\(PASSWORD\|SECRET\|KEY\)=.*/\1=***REDACTED***/I'; echo "=== override ==="; cat docker-compose.override.yaml
